# BuffReminders

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/main/images/logo.png)

  [![](https://shields.io/badge/github-gray?logo=github&style=for-the-badge&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders)
  [![](https://shields.io/badge/discord-5865F2?logo=discord&style=for-the-badge&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/qezQ2hXJJ7)
  [![](https://shields.io/badge/ko--fi-FF5E5B?logo=ko-fi&style=for-the-badge&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/zerbyy)

### Track missing buffs at a glance

Works on Retail and WoW Forever.

From the author of [Raid Buffs Tracker](https://wago.io/iWkZ4Eq-i), one of the most popular raid buffs tracking WeakAuras.

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/main/images/buffs.png)

Check what buffs you or your party are missing, and easily click to cast them!
Supports consumables, pets, and more. Add custom buffs to track whatever you want.

  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/main/images/buffs-split-groups.png)

## Configuration

Type `/br` to open the options panel.
Choose which buffs you want to track and how you want them to look. The panel matches the look of each client.

  

    
Retail

    
WoW Forever

  

  

    
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/main/images/settings-buffs.png)

    
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/main/images/settings-forever.png)

  

## Highlights

- **External buffs (Retail)** - see the Power Infusion, Innervate, Bloodlust, and defensives you receive, even in combat and Mythic+.
- **Custom buffs** - track any spell or item you like.
- **Smart counts** - only alive, connected group members who benefit from a buff are counted, filtered by spec where possible.

## Playing WoW Forever?

BuffReminders comes with extra reminders made just for it:

- **Paladin blessings, sorted out** - pick a main and backup blessing per class, use Greater Blessings, and get warned when another paladin already covers your blessing or aura.
- **Never run out** - low warnings for ammo matched to your bow or gun, and for reagents like Ankhs, Symbol of Kings, and Arcane Powder.
- **Made for leveling** - tracks your buffs on group mates out in the world, reminds you to set up camp and use the Well-Rested sleeping bag, and turns tracking back on after you die.

...and much more.

## Support

Got a bug to report, a feature idea, or just want to see what's coming next? Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/qezQ2hXJJ7)!

If BuffReminders makes your raids a little smoother, consider [supporting development on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/zerbyy) ❤️

# BuffReminders

## [v7.1.1](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/tree/v7.1.1) (2026-11-27)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/compare/v7.1.0...v7.1.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/releases)

### New Features ✨

- **Custom-buffs:**
  - List several click items and use the first one you have
  - Show the icon and stack count of the click item
  - Set the click action and needed items on one tab
- **WoW Forever:**
  - **Mage-armor:** pick the armor to cast in each content
  - **Priest:** remind to keep Fear Ward up
  - **Reagents:** warn per reagent and list all counts on hover
  - **Soulstone:**
    - Remind to keep a Soulstone in the bags
    - Hide the Soulstone reminder on cooldown by default
  - **Tracking:** pick each tracking spell that the reminder offers
  - Pick the stance, form and imbue of each talent group

### Bug Fixes 🐛

- **Click-to-cast:**
  - Highlight the member that a click buffs, not yourself
  - Cast on the ally that the tooltip names
- **Soulstone:** show the Soulstone reminder as soon as its cooldown ends
- **WoW Forever:**
  - **Racials:** show the Attuned or Charged icon as it expires
  - Show what the click casts on an expiring buff icon

### Localization 🌐

- Updated translations: zhTW

### Other Changes 🔧

- 2 internal changes (code cleanup, build and docs). The full changelog lists each one.

# BuffReminders

## [v7.1.0](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/tree/v7.1.0) (2026-11-26)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/compare/v7.0.1...v7.1.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/releases)

### New Features ✨

- **Appearance:**
  - Allow negative spacing so icons can overlap
  - Size each text in pixels with its own control
- **Custom-buffs:** pick spell IDs from your active buffs with /br auras
- **WoW Forever:**
  - **Racials:** remind Skyborne players to get Attuned or Charged
  - **Warlock:**
    - Remind Sacrifice, Pact and Soul Link in order
    - Add a Spellstone and Firestone weapon reminder
    - Choose the demon to sacrifice per content

### Bug Fixes 🐛

- **Appearance:** render every icon gap at its exact pixel width
- **Click-to-cast:**
  - Move the click area with the icon after a set position
  - Stop icon clicks and hover effects while frames are unlocked
  - Cast a newly learned rank without waiting for combat
- **Layout:** leave the coordinate field after Enter applies the position
- Show long buff names in full in the buff list
- **WoW Forever:**
  - **Raid-buffs:** skip players whose scroll or camp buff blocks the cast

### Localization 🌐

- Updated translations: zhTW

### Other Changes 🔧

- 17 internal changes (code cleanup, build and docs). The full changelog lists each one.

# BuffReminders

## [v7.0.0](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/tree/v7.0.0) (2026-11-25)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/compare/v6.11.0...v7.0.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/zerbiniandrea/BuffReminders/releases)

### New Features ✨

- **Appearance:** add a Blizzard icon style that draws the action-button frame
- **Chat-requests:** show default messages and a live preview
- **Expiration:** scale expiration warnings to each buff's duration
- **Snooze:** make /br snooze a toggle, end town snoozes on leaving
- **Soulstone:** hide the Soulstone reminder while solo
- **Tooltips:**
  - Add a key to hold for tooltips and a snooze hint
  - Show what a click uses, on every category's icons
- Add reminder search by name, spell, or class; balance columns
- Add a right-click snooze menu and show alternatives on hover
- **WoW Forever:**
  - **Mage armor:** choose which armor the reminder shows and casts
  - **Sleeping bag:** count down to full Well-Rested stacks in the bag
  - **Tracking:** add creature tracking spells to the tracking reminder
  - Add WoW Forever raid, aura and class self-buff reminders
  - Cast raid buffs on missing members or as the group version
  - Give the options panel a bronze Forever look
  - Add pet, imbue, stance, supply and blessing reminders
  - Mark WoW Forever support as beta in the options and at login
  - Add Drive-by Buffs to buff players you target outside your group
  - Add aura choice, blessing priority, and tank-aware Thorns and Righteous Fury
  - Choose a main and backup blessing per class
  - Right-click blessings and Drive-by Buffs to pick another buff, with a "Next" tooltip
  - Track poisons and stones apart on each weapon, with a rogue poison reminder per hand
  - Request a paladin blessing in chat
  - Cast group buffs on your party once enough members need them
  - Right-click a raid buff to cast its group version
  - Remind to turn gathering tracking back on, with a right-click switch
  - Remind to sleep in the Cozy Sleeping Bag for Well-Rested while leveling
  - Remind holy paladins to swear Oath of Light, solo or in a group
  - Remind to camp: place a fire, sit, and drop features
  - Track your buffs on group mates outside instances and while leveling

### Bug Fixes 🐛

- **Beacons:** stop the Beacon reminder flashing in solo combat
- **Click-to-cast:** cast self buffs on yourself when a friendly target is selected
- **Consumables:** disable the food click while you eat
- **Custom buffs:** respect the expiration glow setting on custom buffs
- **Expiration:**
  - Stop short buffs from showing as expiring right after the cast
  - Stop short consumables from showing as expiring right after use
- **Loadouts:** keep click-to-fix working after an appearance change
- **Poisons:** keep the poison order arrows working after Reset to Default
- **Tooltips:** show the spell tooltip on targeted buffs, with who the click casts on
- Hide a raid buff reminder until its caster learns the spell

### Localization 🌐

- Updated translations: zhTW

### Other Changes 🔧

- 19 internal changes (code cleanup, build and docs). The full changelog lists each one.
